principle: Paladin does not claim progress under literally any condition. It claims safety always within the tested envelope, safe progress when required trust roots and effect dependencies remain available, and explicit refusal when they do not.
fault_classes: single policy or authority dependency unavailable
stale local cache after authority or policy version change
single mutable evidence store tamper with independent anchor intact
catastrophic_boundary: all observation channels controlled by the same adversary
permanent loss of canonical history and backups
